tei:div.tei:p: 837) bar do dgra bzhi lam 'khyer rigs drug gnas sbyong gi lo rgyus/

38 phyi dpa' bo la dor gyi gdams pa/ 39nang dpa' bo la dor gyi gdams pa/ 40gsang ba dpa' bo la dor gyi gdams pa/ 41zab chos kyi spyi chings rnal 'byor bzhi'i khrid/ 42phyag rgya chen po a gcig pad dkar gyi lo rgyus/ 43phyag rgya chen po a gcig pad dkar gyis man ngag 44zab chos gtum mo sum khrid/ 45bsre ba'i zhal gdams rnam rtog gi rlung gnad du bsnun pa'i man ngag 46rnam rtog gi rlung la gnad du bsnun pa'i man ngag bsdus pa/ 47zab lam bsre ba skor gsum gyi chos thun dgu pa/ 48zab lam bsre ba skor gsum gyi don khrid/ 49nā ro pa'i rtsa chings zab chos rtsa rlung ma rin chen 'bar gyi zin bris/ 51rlung gcig la brten nas rigs rgyud spel ba'i rnam bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer/ 5rje nā ro pa chen po'i rtsa chings/ 52'dod chags dbang dang bsre ba nā ro'i rdo rje tshig rkang gi 'grel pa/ 53rje mar pa'i gdams ngag tshigs su bcad pa brgyad pa/ 54mos gus srog 'khor khrid kyi lo rgyus/ 55mos gus srog 'khor gyi dbang bka'/ 56mos gus srog 'khor gyi khrid zhal gdams dang bcas pa/ 57mos gus gsang ba 'dus pa'i yig chung gi gdams pa/ 58dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lhan skyes yab yum gyi mngon rtogs/ 59rtsa rlung rgyu 'bras ma'i rnam bshad/ 60dpal ye shes kyi mgon po nag po chen po'i lo rgyus bsdus pa/ 61dpal ye shes kyi mgon po nag po chen po'i gsang sgrub skor gsum/ 62dpal ye shes kyi mgon po nag po chen po'i thugs sgrub/ 63dpal ye shes kyi mgon po nag po chen po'i dam tshig thugs kyi sgrub thabs/ bla ma rin po che'i gsung gi bdud rtsi tshig gsum gnad kyi man ngag 866phyag rgya chen po gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi zhal gdams rin po che phreng ba/ 68chos khrid gnad bsdus rin chen phreng ba mdzo ra chos khri ma/ 70sgrub pa'i bar chad srung thabs rtsa gsum la brten pa'i gdams pa/

71bdud rtsi'i sgrub thabs dang bsten thabs/ 72ri chos bka' rgya ma gsal byed sgron me/ 73ri khrod 'grims pa gnad kyi chos gsal byed sgron me/ 74'tsho ba'i bcud len rgyun gcod gyi gdams pa/ 75nyon mongs gsum rgyun gcod kyi zhal gdams/ 76gdams ngag skor gsum zhi byed rmang lam ma/ 77snang ba rang sems bka' rgya ma/ 78sngags btsan thabs su ngo sprad pa'i zhus lan bzhi pa/ 79phyi sdom gsum gnad gcig gi man ngag 80nang sdom gsum gnad gcig 81gsang ba sdom gsum gnad gcig 82yang gsang sdom gsum gnad gcig 83de kho na nyid sdom gsum gnad gcig 84rje phag mo gru pa'i rtsa rlung thig le'i zhal gdams/ 85sems rtse gcig gnas pa sna rtse bzhi'i gdams pa/ 86kun gzhi tshogs 'khor ma/ 87'khor lo ma sogs kyi e chung grangs can ma/ 88zab lam nā ro chos drug gi 'khrul 'khor/ 89tshe sgrub yang gsang ga'u kha sbyor/ 90chos drug gsar ma'i rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang mkha' 'gro mas dngos su gsungs pa/ 91'chos drug gsar ma gdams ngag gi khrid gsum dang bcas pa/ 92chos drug gsar ma'i lo rgyus dang zhal gdams/ 93tshe sgrub zhal gdams dri med bdud rtsi'i snying po gnyos la gnang ba/ 94rgyud sde bzhi'i snying po dril ba gser gzhun ltar dril ba/ 95srung 'khor zhal gdams ma/ 96gshis ngo sprod/ 97zhal gdams ri chos bdud rtsi'i bum pa/ 98rgyud sde gcig dril gyi zhu lan/ 99zab chos kyi snying gtam nyi shu rtsa gcig ma/ 100zab chos kyi rtsa tshig bsdus don nor bu'i phreng ba/ yid bzhin nor bu dbang gi rgyal po lta bu'i gdams pa bcu chos/ bcu chos kyi rgyab chos gnad kyi man ngag rta chag steng kha ma/ bcu chos kyi rgyab chos rgyas pa bka' rgya can/ bcu chos rnam dag chos sku'i 'phro bka' rgya can/ bcu chos kyi zhal gdams/ sum chos kyi khrid lo rgyus dang bcas pa/ zab chos 'khor lo bzhi ma'i zur 'debs/

nasum chos 'khor lo ma dge bshes skal ldan la gdams pa/ sum chos gnad kyi man ngag tshangs par spyod pa'i khrid/ sum chos bka' rgya ma/ sum chos rnam dag chos sku'i 'od zer/ sum chos zhal gdams bde chen mkha' 'gro'i srog snying dri ma med pa'i gsung gi bdud rtsi/ sum chos kyi zhal gdams dri ma med pa'i thig le/ chags lam la brten pa'i dam chos zhus lan bzhi pa/
